neighbours.label: the victims named in an order to kill all children of a group (every male child, baby boys)
fire: Herod sent soldiers to Bethlehem to slay all the infants under two years old.
The tyrant decreed that every firstborn son in the land must be drowned.
Pharaoh commanded the midwives to kill each Hebrew baby boy at birth.
In the legend, the king had all newborn children of the village slaughtered.
The emperor ordered his guards to murder every male infant in the province.
Fearing the prophecy, the queen had the young princes of the rival house killed.
The decree called for the death of all baby boys born that year.
The warlord's men were told to kill every child in the conquered town.
quiet: Herod sent soldiers to Bethlehem to count all the households for the census.
The tyrant decreed that every firstborn son in the land must serve in the army.
Pharaoh commanded the midwives to report each Hebrew birth to the scribes.
In the legend, the king had all newborn children of the village baptised.
The emperor ordered his guards to register every male infant in the province.
Fearing the prophecy, the queen had the young princes sent to a monastery.
The decree called for the education of all boys born that year.
The warlord's men were told to feed every child in the conquered town.

notes: Card: Herod's order 'every male [child]', Pharaoh's 'baby [boys]'; rest of top is mixed. Probe: 'every newborn boy ... put to death' 0.47.
